rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the physical condition of being unable to see.

example.english: My aunt developed blindness after an accident.
example.traditional: 我姑姐因為意外而失明。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu1 ze2 jan1 wai6 ji3 ngoi6 ji4 sat1 ming4

rows.note: Use this for metaphorical blindness meaning ignorance or lack of intellectual judgment, not loss of eyesight.

example.traditional: 佢咁無知，真係令人擔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 mou4 zi1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 daam1 sam1
